title: Lie Group Diffusion Models for Hardware-Aware Quantum Circuit Synthesis
summary: An important task in quantum computing is unitary circuit synthesis compatible with physical hardware constraints. This problem has a natural hybrid structure as local single-qubit gates are continuous variables on the Lie group $SU(2)$ while the entangling circuit structure is discrete and hardware-dependent. In this work, we use generative models to perform quantum circuit synthesis incorporating both the natural $SU(2)$ manifold geometry of quantum gates and hardware constraints that determine the overall circuit structure.
